_about: PARKED. Combat's own rows for the launch pair's new strikes and entries, replacing the rows Animation borrowed from wave 1 slots. Fighter keys are the neutral working ids (protagonist, rival). Not loaded, not hashed. offset is the contact distance; reach is the limb's envelope to the socket; lunge and clear are left for Animation's strike_lab to fill on the posed strike.

_manifestDrift._about: Where Animation's manifests at HEAD a56187a (data/anim/waves, render only) still carry a borrowed slot's numbers. Combat's rows here and in strikes.antihero.wave1.json are the ones to regenerate from. Limbs and targets agree everywhere, so the recipes' blur patterns are not affected
